label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To whoever on Aughrim Terrace has been using my bin,

I live at No. 14. The grey bin with the big white 14 painted on the lid. Hard to miss, so I don't think this has been an accident.

For about a month now someone has been filling my bin with full black bags every week. Not a few bits that wouldn't fit in yours, full bags. Last Tuesday I got in from work at 3am and the lid wouldn't even close. Three bags in it that weren't mine, and one of them was full of nappies. Lovely.

My bin is with Greenmount and they charge by weight, 41 cent a kilo. My bill is normally around €25 for two months. The last one was €63.20. That's nearly 40 quid extra, roughly 93 kilos of somebody else's rubbish that I've paid to get rid of. I'm renting, I work nights behind a bar, and I'm not covering your bin bill on top of my own. Not anymore.

I know it's someone on this terrace. One of the bags had a gas bill envelope in it with the address still on it. You were good enough to tear the name off, but the terrace was there in black and white. A car was also seen pulling up on Tuesday evening, so it's not as anonymous as you might think.

If you're stuck and don't have a bin, or you don't know how to sort one out, just knock in and ask. I'll tell you who to ring, it's not hard. I'd honestly rather do that than keep paying for your rubbish.

But the simple version is this: stop. That's all I want. If it keeps happening, the bin gets a padlock and you can find someone else's to fill. I'd rather not have to, but I will.

I'm out late most nights, but I'm around during the day, and I'm not a pushover. I've let this go on longer than I should have.

Cheers,
No. 14
